id: AT-QK-02 (0.1.6 queue check: a queue_cmd the consent rule replaced says why)
note: Run without a program while HOME is not the account home (CR-F34), queue_cmd takes its safe value (empty), and queue check prints the setting's note as status does (`note queue_cmd (HOME is not the account home, safe value used)`) before its FAIL, so the user learns why the value in their settings file was not used. This case runs without the runner's consent seam (consent_home account), as CR-F34 does

steps.name: the safe value's note, then FAIL program
